insight: An AutoML pioneer founded in 2012; a repeat Leader in Gartner's Magic Quadrant for Data Science and ML Platforms.
name: DataRobot
tagline: Enterprise AI platform for building, deploying, and governing ML and agentic AI.
description: DataRobot is an enterprise AI platform spanning the full lifecycle: predictive AI with automated machine learning (AutoML), generative and agentic AI, plus observability and governance. Its AutoML builds and compares many models at once so teams ship production-ready AI faster, and newer agent kits make enterprise AI agents practical to deploy. It runs in the cloud or on-premises for large organizations.

modelSupport.notes: Builds and serves your own ML models and works across many LLMs for generative and agentic AI.

edge: End-to-end enterprise AI: AutoML model-building plus generative and agentic AI, observability, and governance in one governed platform.
pros: One platform across the AI lifecycle
